units.text: Abraham Lincoln issued the Emancipation Proclamation on January 1, 1863.

judgement.reason: The passage identifies the Emancipation Proclamation as Washington, D.C., January 1, 1863, and states the final document would take effect January 1, 1863, with Lincoln approving the final version that day.

units.text: The Emancipation Proclamation was issued from Washington, D.C., as stated in the document's closing clause.

judgement.reason: The closing clause reads 'Done at the City of Washington, this first day of January,' stating the issuance location, and the page also identifies it as Washington, D.C., January 1, 1863.
